items.prompt: Repaint this square fantasy card using the supplied ORIGINAL illustration as the edit target and authoritative reference for character, composition, palette and brushwork. Keep the full-body grey-haired male elf mage exactly as in the reference: round spectacles, black pointed hat with purple lining, black-purple long coat and cape, one hand raised, boots, same pose and scale. Add ONE enormous EYE OF AN ANCIENT ELDRITCH GOD to the upper background, slightly LEFT of center, spanning almost the whole canvas width and occupying roughly the upper third to two fifths, partially occluded by the mage and his raised hand. Design an aesthetically striking cosmic divine eye, ancient, alien, solemn and all-seeing, with an unsettling cold intelligent gaze: a monumental half-open dark almond-shaped aperture formed from smoke and volcanic shadow, a large perfectly abyss-black circular pupil within an uneven muted molten-gold iris ring. The upper lid overlaps and cuts the iris slightly, creating quiet severity and focused scrutiny. The iris is like a broken eclipsed sun, only a few broad asymmetrical molten arcs and simple radial painted wedges, subtly distorted and ancient. Eyelids are huge shadow planes with graceful tapering ends dissolving into fire, not black cartoon outlines. Its glow is buried under smoke, edges intermittent, the eye appears through the existing fire rather than pasted on it. Maintain the original muted charcoal, ochre and pale gold palette with restrained deep burnt-red accents, avoid the over-saturated scarlet of an angry dragon. Eldritch divine presence through scale, impossible depth and restrained shapes; no reptile slit pupil, reptilian skin, scales, eyebrows, lashes, monster face, extra eyes, tentacles, runes or decorative clutter. UNIFIED PAINTING: the same hand-painted matte anime block-brush style as the original mage and fire, broad opaque connected color masses, selective directional brush marks, quiet large surfaces. No photorealism, glossy eyeball, intricate iris filaments, all-over small mosaic marks, digital effects, extra particles, text, border or watermark.
